channel.title: Merkle Street
channel.description: Merkle Street reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, layer 2s, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and protocol upgrades.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, giving them another blockchain route for settling obligations with Visa.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, giving them another blockchain route for settling obligations.

item.title: Kraken xStocks adds 200 UK and EU equities
item.description: Payward added more than 200 UK and EU-listed equities to xStocks, taking its range past 1,500 assets and assets under management above $1.1 billion.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, creating another blockchain route for Visa obligations.

item.title: NYSE Links Tokenized Stock Clearing to Avalanche
item.description: Ava Labs says Avalanche will power clearing for an NYSE-linked tokenized stock venue, with planned 24/7 trading and settlement subject to approval.

item.title: Consensys launches stack to coordinate settlement across ledgers
item.description: Consensys launched a stack for institutional ledgers that coordinates transactions across networks while assets stay put and cross-ledger actions are verified cryptographically.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target blocks to 25 seconds while adjusting rewards and fees to preserve issuance and fund future mining.

item.title: Binance names Justin Yek CFO as Kaiser Ng leaves
item.description: Binance says Kaiser Ng is leaving to pursue a new venture and Justin Yek will take over as CFO, with the handover planned over the past six months.

item.title: Binance traces $6.3 billion security incident to service access
item.description: Binance says a compromised engineer laptop may have enabled unauthorized withdrawals; about $3 billion is frozen as tracing continues and withdrawals remain paused.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korea group
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor stole more than $6bn from Binance; investigators trace Ether swaps and urge crypto services to block laundering routes.

item.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Rules for Stablecoin Issuers
item.description: The OCC finalized GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers and related custody, setting reserve, redemption and oversight requirements that take effect January 18, 2027.

item.title: Centrifuge brings Schroders’ emerging-markets bond fund to Solana
item.description: Centrifuge has put Schroders’ emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana through a tokenized feeder fund, extending onchain investing beyond cash-like products.

item.title: FBI ties $6.34 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI attributes Binance’s October 29 theft of more than $6 billion to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, while Binance says an internal signing service was abused.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34bn hack to fake job and wallet access
item.description: Binance says a fake recruiter’s coding test helped attackers reach wallet systems before $6.34 billion in assets were hit; 98% had been replenished by Oct. 31.

item.title: What a swap slippage limit changes before a trade
item.description: A swap slippage limit sets the minimum output an app will accept, helping you weigh a trade’s chance of execution against price changes before it lands.

item.title: Binance says security breach affected $6.3 billion in crypto
item.description: Binance says a compromised DevOps laptop enabled unauthorized withdrawals affecting about $6.3 billion; the exchange says it will cover losses for users.

item.title: Binance’s $6.3B wallet breach traced to signing systems
item.description: Binance says attackers drained about $6.3 billion from transaction wallets; the FBI blames North Korea’s TraderTraitor group, while issuers froze roughly $3 billion.

item.title: Binance sets phased withdrawal restart after $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance plans to reopen withdrawals in phases after a $6.3 billion hot-wallet breach, while deposits remain open and the exchange replenishes stolen assets.

item.title: How SpookySwap Works: A First Swap, Step by Step
item.description: SpookySwap swaps tokens through liquidity pools on a chosen blockchain; learn how quotes, wallet approvals, fees and price ranges shape a first trade.

item.title: Binance sets phased withdrawals after $6.3bn hack
item.description: Binance plans to reopen withdrawals in phases after a $6.3 billion hack, restoring access across selected networks as security checks continue.
